motivation: R18 reviews requested decision gains at actual source-derived age and a concrete modular boundary. A middle polling interval can alternate response-before-poll and poll-before-response, giving nonconstant actual service gaps rather than the earlier constant-q slow-poll path.
public_source: Same pinned public five MemTest definitions and existing stubs, unchanged. New main configures interval q and initial service only.
admission_before_execution: Follow the finite service-phase graph until a phase repeats. c=p*ceil(s/p)+ell*p. If c=s+q at any reached phase, reject the contract before execution because this study does not establish the native callback/poll tie priority. Otherwise next service is s+q if c<s+q, c+q if c>s+q. Record all rejected configurations, not just favorable cases. Execute all admitted configurations including paths without a phase gain.
derived_class_to_test: For a recurrent admitted cycle with J=max delay>q and P=p, C mod p is {0} and the maximum-delay witness also waits, so its next-completion-to-ingress age is q. Thus M=Gamma and min(F(s+1)-next_s)=M-q: the completion query is exact for actual next-read safety on this class. For n=J+q, a strict sustained phase gain over both completion-uniform and actual-service-uniform bounds occurs iff n mod p !=0, K=floor(n/p)+1, and ((phi+J-1) mod p)>=n mod p. Otherwise no such gain at this period/load. The class condition and exact count are analytic claims to prove separately from finite checks.
query_domain: Each recurrent cycle with J>q; P=p; every phi; K=1..J+q+2. All recurrent configurations and nonqualified/transient cases are reported. Direct actual slack, historical/profile margin, completion margin, RU, per-cycle PP and the stronger actual-service uniform rule are computed at the same source-derived G=q.
main_receiver_checks: Main K4/P5/phi0 cycle intervals [3,11],[11,28]: all size0/1/2 WU subsets of inclusive intervals under WU,decrement,read/cancel. Independent sparse and tick models include both endpoint reads. Full stale-phase prefix actual phi2, WU12 must execute read3/read11, callbacks10/20, decrements12/17/22/27, expiry27, then read28 miss. Same-tick WU11 is cancelled at read11. Stop on first miss.
scientific_boundary: Source execution is in declared packet/RNG/clock/port/event stubs; cache ctarget and receiver model remain premises/source arguments, not native implementation validation. New arithmetic is a secondary analysis after prior data inspection, not unseen empirical prediction or workload prevalence. No source changes, hardware, application performance, area or energy claim. Raw old rounds and all negative controls remain intact.
